\begin{lexlean}{Studio.Gui.Mirror}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\importmodule{Studio.Runtime}
\title{Natural number addition}
\begin{semanticmodule}
definition{
  name: journey,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bytes,
  body: 0x6a6f75726e6579206d6972726f723a205075626c69736820612072656c65617365206f6e63652065766572792067617465207061737365642c2069747320636f6d6d6974732c20746167732c206d6574616461746120616e642070616765732070757368656420746f2074686520676974687562206d6972726f720a
}

definition{
  name: cutPrefix,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bytes,
  body: 0x72656c6561736520
}

definition{
  name: isCut,
  parameters: [answer : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((8 <=? (prim length answer : Nat)) && (Studio.Runtime::sameFrom answer (cutPrefix) 0 8)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: publishEnabled,
  parameters: [maintainerViews : Bool, cutReady : Bool],
  result: Bool,
  body: (maintainerViews && cutReady),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: action,
  parameters: [enabled : Bool],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if enabled then 0x616374696f6e207075626c6973683a20656e61626c6564 else 0x616374696f6e207075626c6973683a2064697361626c6564),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: present,
  parameters: [viewer : Bytes, maintainer : Bytes, answer : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (journey) (prim append (if (isCut answer) then (prim append (prim append 0x76696577206d6972726f7252656164793a20 answer : Bytes) 0x2c20726561647920746f207075626c69736820746f2074686520676974687562206d6972726f720a : Bytes) else (prim append (prim append 0x76696577206d6972726f7248656c643a20 answer : Bytes) 0x0a : Bytes)) (action (publishEnabled (Studio.Runtime::same viewer maintainer) (isCut answer))) : Bytes) : Bytes),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: request,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.cons verb f1 => (match f1
      | List.cons viewer f2 => (match f2
        | List.cons maintainer f3 => (match f3
          | List.cons revision f4 => (match f4
            | List.cons current f5 => (match f5
              | List.cons increment gates => (if (Studio.Runtime::same verb 0x76696577) then (present viewer maintainer (Studio.Runtime::judge revision current increment gates ((prim length value : Nat) + 1))) else 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
              | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
            | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
          | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
        | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
      | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: only_the_maintainer_publishes,
  parameters: [cutReady : Bool],
  statement: ((publishEnabled false cutReady) = false),
  proof: reflexivity{},
  axioms: []
}

theorem{
  name: the_maintainer_publishes_a_cut_release,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a616c657809707269736d3a616c6578096335383763303109302e312e30096d696e6f7209636865636b3a706173736564096275696c643a706173736564) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: another_viewer_cannot_publish,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a6167656e7409707269736d3a616c6578096335383763303109302e312e30096d696e6f7209636865636b3a706173736564096275696c643a706173736564) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: holds_a_release_with_a_failed_gate,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a616c657809707269736d3a616c6578096335383763303109302e312e3009706174636809636865636b3a706173736564096578706f72743a6661696c6564) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
